complexity.notes: The `a = []` followed by `heapq.heapify(a)` is redundant — heapifying an empty list does nothing, and pushing onto a plain empty list already maintains the heap invariant. As written the heap holds all n elements, so both time and space scale with the full array; a better approach keeps only ||a min-heap of size k|| for O(n log k) time and O(k) space, and the optimal one uses ||quickselect (median-of-medians or randomized pivoting)|| for O(n) average time and O(1) extra space.
complexity.summary: Pushes every element onto a max-heap (simulated by negating values in a min-heap), then pops k times so the last popped value is the kth largest.
complexity.time_average: O(n log n + k log n)
complexity.time_worst: O(n log n + k log n)
